{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == '999,999.99'
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

# Remove QA orders
data_clean = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data_clean['revenue'] = data_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = data_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}")

# Check if any refunded orders exist
if refunded_mask.sum() > 0:
    print("Refunded orders found:")
    print(data_clean[refunded_mask][['order_id', 'channel', 'converted', 'revenue']])
else:
    print("No refunded orders found.")

# Now compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = data_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute difference: email minus paid_search
effect = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

print(f"Conversion rate (email): {conversion_rates['email']:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {conversion_rates['paid_search']:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {effect:.4f}")"}
